posts.html:
From factory floors to hot desks, and where it is heading. Most teams already know what to do; the hard part is deciding what to stop doing.

The numbers are less dramatic than the headlines, and more useful. Here is what changed, what did not, and what I would do differently next time.

What I learned

  • Start smaller than feels comfortable
  • Write the decision down
  • Measure one thing, honestly
Simplicity is not the absence of work. It is work, finished.

Further reading

Reply to this email with your own experience; I read every answer and share the best ones next week.
